items.title: 29.6.2 Molecular ion peak aur fragmentation (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the molecular ion peak and fragmentation (PDF 196-199).

blocks.text: Jab sample ke molecules par highly accelerated (bohat tez kiye gaye) electrons ki bombardment (bauchhaar) ki jati hai to molecules apne electrons kho dete hain. Is se aik positive charge wala molecular ion banta hai jis mein aik unpaired (akela) electron hota hai, kyun ke electron beam ne aik pair ka aik electron nikal diya hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Takrane wala electron bhi saath likhein to yahi equation yun banti hai: Molecule + e⁻ → Molecule⁺• + 2e⁻. Dono tareeqe aik hi baat batate hain: molecule ka aik electron nikal gaya.
Molecule⁺• molecular ion ko represent karta (dikhata) hai. Molecular ion aage fragment ho kar (toot kar) naye ions, molecules aur free radicals bana sakta hai.
a) Molecular formula (aur mass) maloom karna
Mass spectrum ki har peak aik khaas m/e wale fragment (tukre) ki hai. Aam taur par sab se zyada m/e wali peak molecular ion (M⁺) peak hoti hai, jo compound ka molecular mass batati hai.

blocks.title: Molecular ion
blocks.text: Molecular ion poora molecule hai jis ne electrons ki beam ki bombardment se aik electron kho diya ho.

[M+1] peak aik chhoti peak hai jo carbon-13 isotope ki natural abundance (qudrat mein maujoodgi) ki wajah se aati hai. Kisi ion ki [M+1] peak ki height (unchai) is par depend karti hai ke molecule mein kitne carbon atoms hain: jitne zyada carbon atoms, utni bari [M+1] peak. Maslan hexane (chhe carbon atoms) ke ion ki [M+1] peak ethane (do carbon atoms) ke ion ki [M+1] peak se oonchi hogi.

blocks.title: Example 29.4
blocks.problem: Kya yeh mass spectrum propanal, CH₃CH₂CHO, ka hai ya butanal, CH₃CH₂CH₂CHO, ka?
steps: Given (diya gaya): mass spectrum; options: propanal, CH₃CH₂CHO, aur butanal, CH₃CH₂CH₂CHO.
Required (maloom karna): spectrum kis compound ka hai?
Spectrum mein sab se zyada m/e wali (molecular ion) peak m/e = 58 par hai.
Molecular ion peak 58 par hai, 72 par nahi.

blocks.alt: Stick (lakeeron wala) mass spectrum, relative intensity (0 se 100) aur m/e (10 se 75). Sab se oonchi peaks m/e 27, 28 aur 29 (taqreeban 60, 90 aur 99) aur m/e 58 (taqreeban 85) par; chhoti peaks 15, 18, 26, 30, 39, 57 aur 59 ke qareeb.
blocks.caption: Example 29.4: mass spectrum (Example 29.4 ke saath chhape spectrum ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.text: b) Fragmentation se molecules pehchanna

Molecular ion peak se compound ka molecular mass maloom hota hai, lekin alag alag compounds ka molecular mass aik jaisa ho sakta hai. Is liye na-maloom compound ka structure maloom karne ke liye fragmentation (tootne ka pattern) dekha jata hai. Fragments (tukre) khaas chhote ions banne se ya chhote molecules ke nikalne se aate hain. Maslan chhote molecules ya fragments ke nikalne se 18 (H₂O), 29 (C₂H₅⁺) aur 44 (CO₂) par peaks aati hain.
Alkanes
Simple (saada) alkanes mass spectrometer mein apne C-C bonds tootne se fragments mein bant jate hain. Kuch common alkane fragments ki m/e values Table 29.3 mein hain.

blocks.caption: Table 29.3 Hexane ke common fragments (aam tukre)

blocks.text: Straight chain (seedhi zanjeer) wala hexane 86, 71, 57, 43, 29 aur 15 par peaks deta hai, kyun ke chain alag alag jagahon se toot'ti hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Har agla fragment pichhle se 14 kam hai, yani aik CH₂ group kam. Table mein C₆H₁₃⁺ (85) bhi hai: yeh molecular ion (86) se aik H nikalne par banta hai.
c) M+1 aur M+2 peaks
i. M+1 peak se carbon atoms ka number maloom karna

[M+1] peak molecule mein carbon-13 (¹³C) isotope ki presence (maujoodgi) se aati hai. Tamam carbon atoms ka taqreeban 1.1% carbon-13 hai. Yeh isotope kam milta hai, is liye [M+1] peak M peak se bohat chhoti hoti hai. ¹³C aur ¹²C ki ratio taqreeban 1:99 hai. Is liye molecule mein jitne zyada carbon atoms, [M+1] peak utni oonchi.
Compound mein carbon atoms ka number, n, [M+1] peak aur is formula se nikala ja sakta hai:

blocks.text_alt: n = (100 × abundance of [M+1]) / (1.1 × abundance of M⁺ ion)

blocks.title: Example 29.5
blocks.problem: Diye gaye mass spectrum se compound X mein carbon atoms ka number maloom karein.
steps: Given (diya gaya): M ion peak m/e 58 par, relative abundance taqreeban 85; [M+1] peak m/e 59 par, relative abundance 3.
Required (maloom karna): carbon atoms ka number, n
Formula: n = (100 × abundance of [M+1]) / (1.1 × abundance of M⁺ ion)
Carbon atoms poore number mein hote hain, is liye n ≈ 3.
blocks.answer: Compound X mein 3 carbon atoms hain.

blocks.alt: Compound X ka stick (lakeeron wala) mass spectrum, relative abundance (0 se 100) aur m/e (10 se 60). m/e 43 (taqreeban 98) aur m/e 58 (taqreeban 84) par oonchi peaks, 15 par peak (taqreeban 24), 59 par chhoti peak (3) aur kuch aur chhoti peaks.
blocks.caption: Example 29.5: compound X ka mass spectrum (Example 29.5 ke saath chhape spectrum ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Is spectrum mein m/e 58 ki oonchi peak M (molecular ion) aur us ke saath 59 ki chhoti peak M+1 hai. In ki heights (taqreeban 85 aur 3) formula n = 100 × 3 / (1.1 × 85) mein dalein to n = 3.21, yani 3 carbon atoms.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke diagram mein 59 wali M+1 peak 3 se thodi oonchi chhapi hai, jab ke kitab ka hal (answer) 3 use karta hai. Hamari drawing mein yeh peak kitab ke text ke mutabiq 3 par hai.
ii. M+2 peak se bromine aur chlorine atoms pehchanna
Compound mein bromine ya chlorine atoms hon to [M+2] peak aati hai, aur kabhi [M+4] peak bhi.
Chlorine
Chlorine ke do isotopes hain: ³⁵Cl aur ³⁷Cl.
Is liye aik chlorine atom wale compound ki do molecular ion peaks hoti hain, kyun ke us mein in do mein se koi bhi isotope ho sakta hai:
Peaks ki heights ki ratio 3:1 hai, kyun ke ³⁵Cl ki relative abundance ³⁷Cl se 3 guna hai.
Do chlorine atoms wale compound ki teen molecular ion peaks hoti hain, kyun ke chlorine isotopes ke teen combinations (mel) ban sakte hain:
Peaks ki heights ki ratio 9:6:1 hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: 9:6:1 kahan se aaya? ³⁵Cl ka chance 3/4 aur ³⁷Cl ka 1/4 hai. Dono ³⁵Cl: 3 × 3 = 9; aik aik: 3 × 1 do tareeqon se = 6; dono ³⁷Cl: 1 × 1 = 1.
Bromine
Bromine ke bhi do isotopes hain: ⁷⁹Br aur ⁸¹Br.
Aik bromine atom wale compound ki do molecular ion peaks hoti hain:
Peaks ki ratio 1:1 hai (dono taqreeban barabar oonchi hain, kyun ke dono isotopes ki relative abundance barabar hai).
Do bromine atoms wale compound ki teen molecular ion peaks hoti hain:
Peaks ki ratio 1:2:1 hai.

blocks.alt: % abundance aur m/e ke chaar stick (lakeeron wale) spectra. 1 Cl atom wale compounds: 35 par 3 (M+ peak) aur 37 par 1 ([M + 2] peak). 2 Cl atoms: 70 par 9 (M+ peak), 72 par 6 ([M + 2] peak) aur 74 par 1 ([M + 4] peak). 1 Br atom: barabar peaks, 79 par 1 (M+ peak) aur 81 par 1 ([M + 2] peak). 2 Br atoms: 158 par 1 (M+ peak), 160 par 2 ([M + 2] peak) aur 162 par 1 ([M + 4] peak).
blocks.caption: Chlorine aur bromine atoms wale compounds ki M+, [M + 2] aur [M + 4] peaks (29.6.2 mein chhape chaar spectra ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Peak ke oopar likha number us ki height ka ratio (tanasub) hai. 2 Br atoms wale compound mein ⁷⁹Br-⁸¹Br do tareeqon (79 + 81 aur 81 + 79) se ban sakta hai, is liye beech wali [M + 2] peak baqi do se doguni oonchi hai (1:2:1).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke '2 Br atoms' wale diagram mein beech wali [M + 2] peak par bhi '1' chhapa hai, halaan ke kitab ka apna ratio 1:2:1 hai aur diagram bhi is peak ko doguna ooncha dikhata hai. Sahi label '2' hai; hamari drawing mein yahi likha hai.
Quick Check 29.3

blocks.prompt: a) In ke tamam possible fragments (mumkin tukre) batayein (straight chain alkanes ki tarah): i) C₄H₁₀ ii) C₅H₁₂ iii) C₇H₁₆
blocks.explanation: i) Butane: C₄H₁₀⁺ 58, C₃H₇⁺ 43, C₂H₅⁺ 29, CH₃⁺ 15. ii) Pentane: C₅H₁₂⁺ 72, C₄H₉⁺ 57, C₃H₇⁺ 43, C₂H₅⁺ 29, CH₃⁺ 15. iii) Heptane: C₇H₁₆⁺ 100, C₆H₁₃⁺ 85, C₅H₁₁⁺ 71, C₄H₉⁺ 57, C₃H₇⁺ 43, C₂H₅⁺ 29, CH₃⁺ 15.

blocks.alt: CH3Br ka stick (lakeeron wala) mass spectrum: % abundance aur m/e (10 se 120). m/e 15 par oonchi peak aur m/e 94 aur 96 par do barabar, thodi chhoti peaks.
blocks.caption: Quick Check 29.3: CH3Br ka mass spectrum (Quick Check mein chhape spectrum ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.prompt: b) CH₃Br ke mass spectrum mein 15, 94 aur 96 par peaks hain. i) Har peak ka fragment pehchanein. ii) 94 aur 96 par do peaks kyun hain?
blocks.explanation: 15 = CH₃⁺; 94 = CH₃⁷⁹Br⁺ aur 96 = CH₃⁸¹Br⁺, yani molecular ions (M aur M+2). Do peaks is liye hain ke bromine ke do isotopes, ⁷⁹Br aur ⁸¹Br, taqreeban barabar abundance (miqdar) mein hain, is liye peaks bhi taqreeban barabar oonchi (1:1) hain.

blocks.text: Summary (khulasa)

items: Sab se zyada m/e wali peak (M⁺) molecular mass batati hai.
Alkanes C-C bonds par toot'te hain (hexane: 86, 71, 57, 43, 29, 15).
